name: Sarah H. Wu
title: PhD student in Media Psychology
bio: Through my research in the Stanford Social Media Lab and Media and Personality Lab, I aim to identify and address situations where technology has the potential to undermine human capacities.

Before starting my PhD, I earned my BA in Psychology from Reed College in Portland, OR, where I conducted research in the Thought Lab and the Academic Motivation Lab. I also worked as a predoctoral researcher at the Stanford Institute for Research in the Social Sciences (IRiSS).

Outside of research, I play violin semi-professionally in Argentine tango ensembles across the Bay Area, including Orquesta Tipica Tarareando. I'm also an "adopted musician" of the Peninsula Symphony, and play assembly concerts for schools in underserved communities.
